subject: Pilot support & in‑kind pricing for UniversityX Accelerator: scope and conversion path
messages:
From: Evan Morales <evan@universityx.edu>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot support request — UniversityX Accelerator

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the intro on the call this morning. UniversityX runs a fall cohort (12 teams) and we'd like to offer each team a lightweight ML infra stipend so they can prototype multi-turn assistants and embeddings for demo day.

High level ask: 1) in-kind free credits usable across hosted Redwood API, 2) a preferential rate if any team converts to Dedicated within 6 months, and 3) a small onboarding session (1-hr tech walk) for our teams.

Budget is limited on our side — we can commit to running a co‑branded demo day and publishing a short case study if we can secure a modest credit package. Can you outline what a starter package might look like (credit size, time window, conversion discount)? Also attaching our accelerator scope so you can see team profiles.

Attachment: UofXAccelerator_Scope.pdf (1 page, program overview)

Best,
Evan Morales
Program Director, UniversityX Accelerator
E: evan@universityx.edu | M: (415) 555-0124


From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Morales <evan@universityx.edu>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot support request — UniversityX Accelerator

Hi Evan — great to meet you on the call earlier. Appreciate the scope you sent.

Short answer: we can definitely support a cohort pilot with in-kind credits + a clear conversion path to Dedicated. A couple of details to align on so I can put a formal proposal together:

- Number of teams: you said ~12; confirm whether all 12 will need token quotas the same week or if usage will be staggered across the quarter.
- Expected peak sequences / embeddings use per team (rough ballpark is fine) so I can size token allowances.
- Do any teams require on-prem or VPC? (That affects conversion pricing/migration).

Provisional starter offer (subject to final sizing and sign-off):
- In-kind credits: 50k tokens per team (600k tokens total), valid for 90 days.
- Onboarding: 60-minute group tech walk + office hours (2 x 30m) with our Developer Success engineer.
- Conversion incentive: 20% committed discount on Redwood Dedicated (first 6 months) if a team signs a Dedicated MRR commitment within 180 days of pilot activation.

I'll loop in Ben and Irene to confirm pricing/billing mechanics and whether we need a formal MOU. If that sounds directionally fine, I can send a short MOU and a HubSpot deal draft.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
Tel: (650) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Pilot support request — UniversityX Accelerator

Thanks Aisha & Evan — happy to help. Quick clarifications from pricing ops perspective:

- The 50k tokens/team is reasonable as a starter. If usage looks light we can top-up an additional 25k tokens per team (one-time) — we can attach a conditional clause to the MOU.
- The 20% conversion discount to Dedicated is doable for a 6-month period but requires a minimum committed baseline if the customer wants reserved capacity pricing (we typically ask for a 3-month commit at a baseline throughput). We can present two conversion tracks:
  a) Hosted-to-Dedicated fast-track: 20% off list Dedicated hourly rates for first 6 months + migration credits (one-time engineering migration credit up to $2,500) — requires a signed Dedicated commitment of at least $6,000/mo.
  b) Self-serve conversion: 10% off list for teams that convert without reserved capacity commit.

- Legal: we'll need a short MOU. I'll attach a draft MOU with the conditional top-up language and marketing release for the case study.

Attachment: MOU_draft.docx (stub)

Ben Carter
Director, Startup Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Hi Ben / Aisha — thanks for the clear options. A few items from our side:

- Teams will ramp across weeks 1–8 (staggered); peak usage concentrated in weeks 6–8.
- Estimate per-team usage: a handful of multi-turn chats for demonstrations (~20–40k tokens total) + 5–10k embedding queries. So 50k tokens per team looks like a good baseline.
- No VPC/on-prem needs — all hosted.

The conversion tracks are helpful. Two asks: can you confirm the pricing floor for the Dedicated $6,000/mo commit (what throughput does that buy)? Also, the migration credit sounds useful — would that cover a short data egress/export if teams wanted to bring KV caches?

If the MOU can include a clause to allow one supplemental top-up of credits per team (25k) at Redwood's discretion, we're happy to proceed. Evan will sign the MOU, and we'll coordinate marketing approvals for the case study.

Best,
Evan

Hi all — quick ops note on billing/tax and the migration credit:

- Billing: for in-kind credits we issue a zero-dollar promotional line item on a short pilot agreement (MOU) — no invoice required for the credits themselves. If any team converts to Dedicated and signs a committed plan, billing will start on the committed date and we will offset the migration credit against the first invoice as an invoice credit (up to $2,500 per conversion where applicable).
- Dedicated $6,000/mo baseline: that typically maps to a small reserved pool (1 x 8-GPU equivalent shared capacity) aimed at predictable throughput; exact throughput depends on model family and token length. We'll share a quick SLO/throughput table in the MOU appendix so teams can check.
- Tax: since UniversityX is a nonprofit educational program, provide a tax-exempt certificate and we'll route the pilot MOU through our nonprofit handling process — this will suppress any standard tax charges on billable items.

I'll update the MOU_draft with the above clarifications and the conditional top-up clause. Aisha — if you want, I can upload the updated MOU to the HubSpot deal and trigger an e-sign link.

--
Irene Choi
Manager, Pricing & Billing Ops | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
